allowed_texts: exact reviewed literal text, not inferred from source by candidate
fields.meaning: REFERENCE_KEY | ROW_UNIT | ENDPOINT_DEFINITION | CONDITION_SCOPE | MISSINGNESS | PROVENANCE | CITATION
fields.unit: null | MPa | percent | C | h | um | mm | 1/s | weight_percent

expected_diagnostic: Explicit complete bounded G34.inspect_synthetic_headers(raw, selected_growth=True) projection, frozen outside candidate. Exact equality is required before XML; candidate also requires sole MEMBER_KIND_PROFILE failure, every other family checked/pass without partials, selected-growth match and successful cleanup. Arbitrary generated progress may differ from actual; production later has no caller expectation. No actual identity accepted.

metadata_columns.meaning: REFERENCE_KEY | TEST_ID | SPECIMEN_ID | HEAT_ID | BATCH_ID | CAMPAIGN_ID | CONDITION | MATERIAL_ID

row_classes.class: HEADER | DATA | BLANK | NOTE | SUMMARY | UNRESOLVED

record_roles.sheet_name: exact namespace-qualified workbook binding by sheet name and r:id; no ordinal

reference_keys: exact reviewed keys, bounded; duplicate keys rejected; no DOI-only inference
required_documentary_fields: documentary field IDs whose manifest-supported assertions the frame relies on

frame_rows: row_classes must cover every explicit XML row exactly; no extra or omitted rows. BLANK requires no explicit cells; header/note/summary/unknown assignments are manifest premises. Complete all-row accounting remains, with metadata only for DATA rows and unresolved/blank/header row identities retained. Any target column overlapping metadata fails before values. Endpoint presence/type/formula flags are structural, never numerical validity or complete pairs.
overlap_manifest: Optional exact object {schema:li_v3.target_redacted_overlap.v1, authenticated:true, identity_sha256:<digest>, field_id:<one metadata identifier>, exposed_keys:[<reviewed exact lineage keys>]}. Claimed authentication remains an explicit supplied premise in pure tests; production must independently bind its provenance. Key matches describe provenance-key overlap, never automatic measurement identity or physical independence.
report: schema, synthetic_fixture, production_binding=null, phase, status=BLOCKED_SCHEMA, engineering_status, reason, validation_reason_before_cleanup, source_sha256, replay_matched, package, roles, documentary, frame, exposure, numeric_outcome_interpretation=false, formula_evaluation=false, scientific_eligibility_decisions=false, sampling_independence_established=false, scientific_counts=null, fits=0,splits=0. Payload fields null until completed; cleanup/serialization failure clears them.
semantics: Parser cannot establish prose meaning. DOCUMENTARY plus exact allowed_texts is a source-bound reviewed premise, exposed as MANIFEST_ASSERTION. MIXED/unreviewed required mapping blocks; unresolved optional fields retain unknown without text. No text classifier, digit stripping, semantic safety or full workbook rendering claim.
